documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Considering, Approving & Taking On Record The Unaudited Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter And Half Year Ended On September 30, 2026 And To Conduct Any Other Businesses As May Be Decided By The Board.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of EGM

analysis.summary: D.P. Abhushan Limited reported a total revenue of INR 853.63 crores in Q1 FY27, representing a 58% year-on-year growth driven by summer wedding and festive demand. Operating EBITDA grew 70% year-on-year to INR 93.99 crores, with EBITDA margins expanding by 80 basis points to 11.01%. The company announced expansion into Dahod, Gujarat, and its first FOCO model store in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, while targeting 5 to 6 new store additions for the current fiscal year. Management targets 10% volume growth for FY27 and FY28 and aims to increase its studded jewellery share to 12%-15% by March 2028.

guidance.claim: D.P. Abhushan is targeting approximately 10% volume growth going forward.
guidance.quote: Broadly, we are targeting around 10% volume growth going forward.

guidance.claim: The company targets volume growth of around 10% for both FY27 and FY28.
guidance.quote: Internally, we are planning for approximately 10% volume growth, and that remains our broad target for both FY27 and FY28.

guidance.claim: D.P. Abhushan aims to increase its overall studded jewellery mix to between 12% and 15% by March 2028.
guidance.quote: And we have targeted by March ‘28, we would like to increase up to 12% to 15% on an overall basis.

guidance.claim: The company plans to expand its retail store footprint across Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities in five states over the upcoming five years.
guidance.quote: Plans to Expand in Tier 2 & 3 Cities in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh , Gujarat and Maharashtra in upcoming 5 years.

guidance.claim: The company aims to achieve an annual growth rate of 25% to 30% by the end of 2030.
guidance.quote: Over the next five years, by the end of 2030, we aim to grow at an annual rate of approximately 25% to 30%.

guidance.claim: Management guides EBITDA margin to be around 6% to 6.5%.
guidance.quote: Our margin guidance will be around 6% to 6.5%, EBITDA margin.

guidance.claim: The company plans to generate revenues of INR 4,800 crores in FY27 and INR 5,500 crores in FY28.
guidance.quote: So FY27 and FY28, the revenue we are planning around like 20%, 25% growth. So INR4,800 crores, and the next year will be INR5,500 crores.

guidance.claim: Management targets EBITDA margins of 8% to 8.5% by 2030.
guidance.quote: So, we are targeting EBITDA margins to remain between 8% and 8.5%, which is our FY30 vision already in place.

demand_outlook.claim: Total revenue for Q1 FY27 stood at INR 853.63 crores, registering a 58% year-on-year growth.
demand_outlook.quote: During Quarter 1 '27, our total revenue stood at INR853.63 crores as compared to INR541 crores in Quarter 1 FY26, registering a strong growth of 58% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Store footfall-to-conversion ratio reached 81% during Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: In Q1 FY27, footfall at our stores was encouraging, and the footfall-to-conversion ratio stood at 81%, showing strong buying intent and effective in-store engagement.

demand_outlook.claim: Average ticket size in Q1 FY27 was approximately Rs. 1,57,000.
demand_outlook.quote: During the quarter, our average ticket size was approximately Rs. 1,57,000, supported by wedding-led purchases and festive demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Gold volume growth stood at approximately 1% to 2% in Q1 FY27 compared to Q1 FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: When we compare Q1 FY27 with Q1 FY26, we have delivered volume growth of approximately 1% to 2%.

demand_outlook.claim: Customer demand remained healthy across the company's markets during Q1 FY27, backed by consumption-led and investment-led purchases.
demand_outlook.quote: Customer demand remained healthy across our markets during the quarter, supported by both consumption-led and investment-led purchases.

demand_outlook.claim: The company witnessed encouraging traction in its gold exchange business and D.P. Swarna Plus Scheme during the quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: We witnessed encouraging traction in our gold exchange business and D.P. Swarna Plus Scheme, reflecting customers' increasing preference for planned jewellery purchases and efficient monetisation of existing gold holdings.

demand_outlook.claim: Old gold exchange contributed approximately 25% of total sales in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Following recent government announcements and heightened customer awareness, participation in gold exchange transactions strengthened further, with old gold exchange contributing approximately 25% of total sales in Q1 FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Jewellery demand remains resilient despite elevated gold prices, especially in wedding-driven purchases.
demand_outlook.quote: Even in periods of elevated gold prices, we continue to see jewellery demand remain resilient, especially in wedding-led purchases and relationship-driven markets like ours.

demand_outlook.claim: Rising gold prices have encouraged consumers to shift toward lighter designs.
demand_outlook.quote: Rising gold prices have pushed consumers toward lighter designs.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects revenue growth of around 20% going forward driven by wedding demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Yes, we are confident of achieving growth of around 20% going forward, driven by strong wedding demand in the country.

demand_outlook.claim: Overall volume declined by around 20% in FY26 while growth was driven by value.
demand_outlook.quote: In FY26, most of our growth was driven by value rather than volume. On the volume side, we actually saw a decline of around 20% overall.

demand_outlook.claim: Old gold exchange currently contributes around 35% to 40% of sales.
demand_outlook.quote: So, the old gold exchange is somewhere 35% to 40% as of now.

demand_outlook.claim: Silver demand remains strong as consumers shift towards silver due to rising gold prices.
demand_outlook.quote: Silver demand remains intact. In fact, with gold prices increasing and impacting demand, we are seeing a shift towards silver.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has finalized showroom locations in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, and Dahod, Gujarat.
capex_expansion.quote: Under this roadmap, we have successfully finalized the locations for new showrooms in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, and Dahod, Gujarat.

capex_expansion.claim: The Dahod showroom will measure around 3,200 square feet under the COCO model.
capex_expansion.quote: The Dahod showroom will be approximately 3,200 sq. ft. and will mark our strategic entry into the Gujarat market.

capex_expansion.claim: The Jabalpur store will span approximately 3,750 square feet as the company's first FOCO showroom.
capex_expansion.quote: Our second showroom, in Jabalpur, will be approximately 3,750 sq. ft. and will be our first Franchisee-Owned Company-Operated model showroom.

capex_expansion.claim: The company targets adding five to six new stores in the current year.
capex_expansion.quote: For this year as well, we are targeting the addition of approximately five to six new stores.

capex_expansion.claim: Store expansion continues to be a core element of the company's long-term growth strategy.
capex_expansion.quote: Expansion continues to remain a key pillar of our long-term growth strategy. We are steadily deepening our presence across high-potential markets through a disciplined store rollout approach.

capex_expansion.claim: Locations have been finalized for upcoming showrooms in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh and Dahod, Gujarat.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has successfully finalized locations for its upcoming showrooms in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh and Dahod, Gujarat, with all key agreements, approvals, and necessary formalities completed.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to open three to four new COCO stores in the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: For this year, we have planned to open three to four new stores.

capex_expansion.claim: D.P. Abhushan has finalized and plans to open its first franchise store.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, we have already finalized one franchisee and will be opening one franchise store as well.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to open a store in Jodhpur and targets entering Jaipur in the next one to two years.
capex_expansion.quote: We are planning to open a store in Jodhpur, and Jaipur is definitely part of our future expansion roadmap.

capex_expansion.claim: D.P. Abhushan aims to reach a total network of around 51 stores by 2030.
capex_expansion.quote: Our long-term goal is to reach around 51 stores by 2030.

capex_expansion.claim: Depending on market conditions, the company may open five to six stores or a conservative three to four stores this year.
capex_expansion.quote: If everything remains under control. We will open around five to six stores this year, and we plan to continue at a similar pace next year.

margins_costs.claim: Operating EBITDA increased 70% year-on-year to INR 93.99 crores in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: At operating level, EBITDA increased by 70% year-on-year to INR93.99 crores in Q1 '27 as compared to INR55 crores in Q1 '26.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin expanded to 7.55% in Q1 FY27, up 82 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin expanded to 7.55%, up 82 basis points year-on-year, reflecting strong profitability growth and sustained efficiency across the businesses.

margins_costs.claim: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin stood at 5.45%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin for the quarter stood at 5.45%.

margins_costs.claim: FY26 EBITDA margins reached 7.61%, representing an expansion of 234 basis points over FY25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR309.7 crores, reflecting a strong growth of 77% YoY, with EBITDA margins improving to 7.61%, an expansion of 234 basis points over FY25.

margins_costs.claim: Around 28% to 30% of inventory gains were reflected in the books during FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Approximately 28% to 30% of the inventory gains have been reflected in our books.

margins_costs.claim: The company expects to maintain a gross margin level of approximately 10% to 11%.
margins_costs.quote: As far as gross margins are concerned, we expect the business to maintain approximately 10% to 11%.

margins_costs.claim: The online segment is anticipated to contribute an additional INR 25 to INR 30 crores in annual profit.
margins_costs.quote: In terms of profitability, we expect this segment to contribute an incremental INR25 to INR30 crores in profit annually.

orders_capacity.claim: Overall same-store sales growth stood at 52% in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Our same-store sales growth stood at 52% on an overall basis.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates with an annual inventory turnover ratio of around 4.7x to 5.0x.
orders_capacity.quote: Our business currently operates with an inventory turnover ratio of around 4.7x to 5.0x annually, which, in our view, is among the best in the industry.

orders_capacity.claim: Total retail store area stood at ~53,650 square feet in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Our total retail store area stood at ~53,650 sq. ft. supporting our growing scale of operations.

orders_capacity.claim: Retail sales productivity reached ~INR 7.6 lakhs per sq. ft. and ~INR 339 crores per store for FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: On the productivity front, we delivered an average revenue of ~INR7.6 lakhs per sq. ft. and ~INR339 crores per store for FY26, reflecting strong store-level performance and efficient utilization of retail space.

orders_capacity.claim: Same-store sales growth stood at ~20% Year-on-Year.
orders_capacity.quote: So yeah, the number of the same-store sales growth is ~20% is the SSG growth.

orders_capacity.claim: Normalized inventory days for the business model are expected to remain between 75 to 85 days.
orders_capacity.quote: It is going to remain between 75 to 85 days, not more than that far as our business model is concerned.

capital_allocation.claim: D.P. Abhushan utilizes exchange-led procurement, gold metal loans, and commodity hedging to mitigate gold price volatility and improve working capital.
capital_allocation.quote: The company continues to leverage exchange led procurement of gold, gold metal loan, and hedging mechanisms on the commodity exchange platform to mitigate gold price volatility, support margin stability, and improve working capital efficiency.

capital_allocation.claim: The company aims to improve capital efficiency by reducing reliance on fresh gold procurement through gold exchange schemes and the D.P. Swarna Plus Scheme.
capital_allocation.quote: Reducing dependence on fresh gold procurement through exchange-led scheme and Structured Gold Savings Accumulation Scheme, thereby improving capital efficiency and sustaining sales even at higher gold prices.

capital_allocation.claim: The company utilizes Gold Metal Loans and exchange hedging mechanisms to manage working capital efficiency and gold price volatility.
capital_allocation.quote: Continue to follow a disciplined approach towards gold procurement and inventory management, exchange gold, leveraging Gold Metal Loans (GMLs) and hedging mechanisms at commodity exchange platform to mitigate gold price volatility while supporting margin stability and working capital efficiency.

capital_allocation.claim: The planned QIP has been put on hold due to unfavourable market conditions.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes, we are planning to undertake a QIP; however, we have currently put it on hold as market conditions are not favourable.

capital_allocation.claim: Expansion plans for FY27 and FY28 will be executed through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: As far as our expansion plans for FY27 and FY28 are concerned, they will be executed through internal accruals as well.

capital_allocation.claim: The company currently has no plans for long-term borrowings.
capital_allocation.quote: No, we have not yet planned for any long-term borrowings.

capital_allocation.claim: The promoter equity dilution under the proposed QIP is targeted between 5% and 8%.
capital_allocation.quote: But yes, we have targeted that it is going to be diluted between 5% to 8%.

risks_headwinds.claim: The increase in gold import duty from 6% to 15% in May 2026 introduced near-term cost and demand sensitivity.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the recent government announcement and increase in gold import duty from 6% to 15% in May 2026 has introduced near-term cost and demand sensitivity, the long-term fundamentals of the sector remain intact, supported by India’s cultural affinity for gold, wedding and festive led demand, rising formalisation, omnichannel adoption.

risks_headwinds.claim: The inventory carrying value in books is approximately INR 1,20,000 compared to prevailing gold market prices of INR 1,51,000 to INR 1,52,000.
risks_headwinds.quote: As of today, if we look at the prevailing gold price, it is trading at around INR1,51,000 - INR1,52,000 whereas the inventory value reflected in our books is approximately INR1,20,000.

risks_headwinds.claim: The government increased the gold and silver import duty from ~6% to 15%.
risks_headwinds.quote: Government raised the import duty on gold (and silver) from ~6% to 15%.

risks_headwinds.claim: India's gold demand in CY26 is expected to remain between 600–700 tonnes as elevated prices impact jewellery consumption.
risks_headwinds.quote: India’s gold demand is projected to remain in the range of 600–700 tonnes in 2026, with rising investment demand offsetting weaker jewellery consumption due to elevated gold prices.

risks_headwinds.claim: Gold price volatility and upward movement during FY26 impacted affordability and consumer purchasing patterns.
risks_headwinds.quote: Throughout FY26, gold prices were on an upward trajectory and quite volatile, which impacted affordability and consumer buying patterns.

risks_headwinds.claim: Fluctuations in gold prices recently caused an impact on consumer sentiment.
risks_headwinds.quote: Recently, we have seen some impact due to fluctuations in gold prices.

risks_headwinds.claim: Statements from the Prime Minister regarding mindful spending may have a slight short-term impact on consumer sentiment.
risks_headwinds.quote: See, the Prime Minister’s statement may have a slight short-term impact on sentiment, but overall, we believe the underlying demand for gold remains strong.

management_commitments.quote: Internally, we are planning for approximately 10% volume growth, and that remains our broad target for both FY27 and FY28.

management_commitments.quote: And we have targeted by March ‘28, we would like to increase up to 12% to 15% on an overall basis.

management_commitments.quote: For this year as well, we are targeting the addition of approximately five to six new stores.

management_commitments.quote: Plans to Expand in Tier 2 & 3 Cities in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh , Gujarat and Maharashtra in upcoming 5 years.

management_commitments.claim: Fit-out activities are under progress for the upcoming Dahod and Jabalpur showrooms, which are expected to open shortly.
management_commitments.quote: Fit-out and showroom development activities are progressing at both locations, and the stores are expected to become operational shortly.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to achieve an annual growth rate of 25% to 30% by the end of 2030.
management_commitments.quote: Over the next five years, by the end of 2030, we aim to grow at an annual rate of approximately 25% to 30%.

management_commitments.quote: So FY27 and FY28, the revenue we are planning around like 20%, 25% growth. So INR4,800 crores, and the next year will be INR5,500 crores.

management_commitments.quote: Our long-term goal is to reach around 51 stores by 2030.

management_commitments.quote: So, we are targeting EBITDA margins to remain between 8% and 8.5%, which is our FY30 vision already in place.

management_commitments.quote: We are targeting Jaipur in the next one to two years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
